desc: Script to download DMTF CIM Schema for Small-Footprint CIM Broker (sfcb)
r: getSchema - Script to download DMTF CIM Schema for Small-Footprint CIM Broker (sfcb)

getSchema is a small script to automatically downlaod and install the latest CIM Schema from the DMTF website. The CIM Schema is required by the Small-Footprint CIM Broker (sfcb) to be able to install and register new classes. getSchema uses curl to fetch the CIM Schema tarball.

Supported command line options are:

schemadir
Path to download the CIM Schema tarball and extract all the CIM classes. Default is /usr/share/sfcb
-f
Force option. Without this option you will be prompted if an existing schema is already found in the target schemadir. Setting this option will reinstall the new CIM Schema without prompting.
